details.services_summary: Development and maintenance of booking engine, fare search and reporting modules for an online travel booking business.

liability_cap.basis: fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim
liability_cap.quote: The aggregate liability of the Service Provider shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (l2) months preceding the claim.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Service Provider shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: develop, license or provide travel-booking software
restrictive_covenants.quote: it shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India.

findings.title: Restrictive non-compete clause against online travel agencies
findings.why: Restricts AtliQ from serving the travel-booking software sector in India for 12 months post-termination, limiting business growth.
findings.comparison: AtliQ principles avoid restrictive covenants and non-competes as they clash with existing promises and market opportunities.
findings.quote: it shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India.

findings.title: Illegible text near negligence exclusion in indemnity
findings.why: The clause contains illegible text surrounding negligence, creating ambiguity on whether AtliQ covers client's own negligence.
findings.comparison: Principles state AtliQ does not cover the other side's own negligence; unreadable text prevents proper verification.

findings.title: Al Noor Hospitality Group: Data analytics, AI or revenue-management services
findings.why: Hospitality client; the region is outside the restriction as stated, but confirm that no property in the GCC is included.
findings.comparison: Do not take analytics, AI or revenue-management work for hotel groups in the GCC until about September 2029 without Al Noor's written consent.
findings.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 12.4 lets Al Noor waive it per engagement by written consent. Waiver letter of 10 Feb 2026 allows only the Seaside Hotels (Muscat) demand-forecasting SOW; not follow-on SOWs, other hotels or Affiliates.

findings.title: Expired restriction: Orbit Travels (Developing, licensing or providing travel-booking software)
findings.why: The new deal involves developing travel-booking software for an online travel agency in India, which directly collides with the non-compete commitment restricting developing travel-booking software for online travel agencies in India until 2025-06-30.
findings.comparison: Expired. Shown for confidence: AtliQ could not build travel-booking software for Indian online travel agencies until 30 June 2025.
findings.quote: it shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India.
findings.exception: Clause 6.2: hotels, airlines and other businesses that are not online travel agencies are not restricted. Scanned copy with OCR errors; read with care.
